purpose: Check whether the caption font depends on the game locale
protocol: Same installed DLL, only the game language changed between runs. Same page (Options top level), same headset, same session.

en.bands_between_rows: filled with a wide run of '?' characters

conclusion.falsified_model: caption elements resolve to 'menu' -> RU fallback / US font
conclusion.dead_hypothesis_evidence: identical glyphs in RU and EN despite different locale font registries
remaining_facts: 0x80..0xFF have no glyphs (tofu in EN, nothing in RU)
font choice does not change with the game locale

new_hypothesis.statement: Caption elements use a fixed, locale-independent font with a 256-entry identity-order table whose atlas contains only ASCII glyphs.
new_hypothesis.reason: font\font_arial has the same path in fonts_ru.bin and fonts_us.bin

separate_symptom.what: The row bands are empty in RU and '?' in EN.
separate_symptom.interpretation: Those elements do take the locale charmap font: RU indices are out of range in the US 203-entry table -> '?'. They are a different code path from the captions and must not be used as evidence about the caption font.
separate_symptom.open_question: Why are they invisible in RU rather than Cyrillic?

corrections_to_previous_reports: L-0002 §3/§5: the 'menu' fallback model is falsified by this run.
L-0002 §7 item 1-2 (find menu fallback / default): superseded, do not spend time on it.
ru/ENCODING_NOTES.md §1: 'ВКЛ -> PJ/' does not reproduce in 0.9.0 charmap in either locale.
next_static_questions: In 0x9b3a0 / 0x91440 / 0x958d0, what value does the font_name field of a caption element get when the mod does not set it?
Is there a constant pointer to an existing font-name string in the text-element constructor path?
Which alias does the exe substitute for an empty font_name on a text element (candidate: arial)?
Cost of patching font_name to 'main_menu' for the element the mod creates (RU only).

static_lead.context: this = [rbp+0x1d8], arg rdx = &[rbp+0x1a0] (std::string), dl = is-heap flag
static_lead.interpretation: candidate SetCaption(std::string); no SetFont-like second virtual call on the same object
static_lead.follow_up: find where [rbp+0x1d8] comes from and whether it is the parsed menu element with the font_name field
